property_summary: After calling allowance (which triggers a delegate call to the share contract that, in the buggy version, calls deny which sets wards[caller]=1 instead of 0), the caller becomes authorized in M but not in P; the test verifies that c.wards(caller) is 0 in P but 1 in M.
change_summary: Replace 'wards[user] = 0;' with 'wards[user] = 1;' so that deny actually authorizes instead of denying.
